rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０１７＿００１That's not it! I'm saying it for￥everyone's sake!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿００３Set up like this, it's no good￥for training at all!!
＊Engineer＊＠０１７＿００６I'm sorry, but I still have￥work to finish.￥If you'll excuse me.
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿００９Why won't anyone understand?!＝＠０１７＿０１０If you won't understand,￥then forget it!!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０１３Ugh, listen to this!!￥Everyone's being so mean!!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０１４Everyone treats me like a kid!￥Sakaki, the engineer...
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０１５Sakaki and the engineer!!￥They all treat me like a kid!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０１６I was thinking of everyone when￥I spoke up...! It's about the￥simulator levels!＝＠０１７＿０１７I've been thinking for a while--￥if we stay at the current level,￥we won't improve much...
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０１８So I asked them to change the￥level to match each candidate's￥ability.＝＠０１７＿０１９And then...
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２０The engineer... and even Sakaki￥treated me like a kid! They￥wouldn't listen at all!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２１I'm a candidate too, you know!＝＠０１７＿０２２Besides, what I'm saying would￥be good for everyone!!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２３Yeah! Obviously everyone would￥have an easier time that way!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２４It would! Deep down, I bet￥everyone wants it that way!
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２７Why... is it wrong to change￥the level for each person?
A test has to be fair.
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２８Because it's a test...?￥You mean everyone has to have￥the same conditions?
＊Amane＊＠０１７＿０２９A reason...? What reason...＝＠０１７＿０３０You mean the engineer is￥keeping the level the same￥on purpose...?
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００１The engineer, Sakaki, and you￥too... What are you all trying￥to say?
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００２You mean if the settings create￥gaps in skill, that's bad?￥...But...
So they leave it as is.
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００４I see... So that's why the￥engineer didn't like my idea...
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００５Unfair, huh... Right. Without￥the same conditions, the test￥would be pointless.＝＠０１８＿００６I thought it'd be a great way to￥help everyone build on their￥strengths, though...
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００７I see...＝＠０１８＿００８Was I... was I just being￥selfish...?
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿００９Going on about "everyone's￥sake"... when I didn't get￥a thing. I feel so stupid...
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿０１２I forgot something important!￥I have to go apologize to the￥engineer and Sakaki!!
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿０１４The engineer!! Sakaki!!￥What do I do?!￥I-I'm going right now!!
＊Amane＊＠０１８＿０１６Sorry for all the trouble.￥Thanks a bunch!!
